title: "The Evaluation Is Wrong, Teacher!"
description: Steven talks about students saying his teaching evaluation scores were wrong, a class observation that got called "impressive," and his approach of more student talk, fun lessons, Claude-made flashcards and leaving deep grammar questions to AI. He also explains his new overnight setup where Gemini and OpenAI check the content Claude makes.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目里，史蒂文聊了几件事：有学生坚持说他的教学评价“打错了分”；班主任听完他的课，评价是“令人印象深刻”。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about a few things: a student insists that his teaching evaluation was "scored wrong," and after observing his class, the head teacher called it "impressive."

sentences.zh: 他还讲了自己的教学思路：学生开口的时间要比老师多，课堂要有趣，语法的深入解析不如交给 DeepSeek。
sentences.en: He also explains his teaching approach: students should talk more than the teacher, classes should be fun, and in-depth grammar explanations are better left to DeepSeek.

sentences.zh: 此外，他谈到了 Claude 做的单词卡和三周后的口语期中考试。
sentences.en: He also talks about the flashcards made by Claude and the oral midterm exam three weeks from now.

sentences.zh: 最后，他分享了最新的 AI 实验：让机器人在夜里互相检查工作。
sentences.en: Finally, he shares his latest AI experiment: having bots check each other's work overnight.

sentences.zh: “评价打错了，老师”
sentences.en: "The evaluation was marked wrong, teacher"

sentences.zh: 上周，学生们填了教学评价问卷，昨天史蒂文把结果给大家看了。
sentences.en: Last week, the students filled out a teaching evaluation questionnaire, and yesterday Steven showed everyone the results.

sentences.zh: 图上他的蓝线比平均水平的橙线略微靠里。
sentences.en: On the chart, his blue line sat slightly inside the orange line for the average.

sentences.zh: 答疑时间和“学生喜不喜欢这门课”这两项，他都低于平均值。
sentences.en: On both office hours and "whether students like the course," he was below average.

sentences.zh: 今天，一个金融专业、一个工程专业的学生分别来找他，都说评价是错的，他们其实很喜欢这门课。
sentences.en: Today, a finance student and an engineering student each came to see him separately, both saying the evaluation was wrong and that they actually really like the course.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得挺暖心。
sentences.en: Steven found it quite heartwarming.

sentences.zh: 说到答疑时间，他要求学生两人一组练雅思口语题，这是十五到二十分钟纯粹的口语练习。
sentences.en: As for office hours, he has students practice IELTS speaking questions in pairs, which is fifteen to twenty minutes of pure speaking practice.

sentences.zh: 低分也许来自那一两个从不露面的学生。
sentences.en: The low scores may have come from the one or two students who never show up.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“不是你的问题，老师，是我不在乎，我不想去。”
sentences.en: In his words: "It's not your problem, teacher, it's that I don't care, I don't want to go."

sentences.zh: 这倒也坦率。
sentences.en: That's honest, at least.

sentences.zh: 作文、小测和周五的打印机赌局
sentences.en: Essays, quizzes, and the Friday printer gamble

sentences.zh: 说实话，他聊评价，一部分是因为担心这节课的内容不够多。
sentences.en: To be honest, part of the reason he talked about grading is that he was worried this lesson didn't have enough content.

sentences.zh: 明天他要批改全部五十篇作文，希望周五或下周二发回去。
sentences.en: Tomorrow he has to grade all fifty essays, and he hopes to hand them back on Friday or next Tuesday.

sentences.zh: 周五他还得打印第五次小测，前提是打印机有墨、有纸，而且肯争气。
sentences.en: On Friday he also has to print the fifth quiz, provided the printer has ink and paper and actually cooperates.

sentences.zh: 录下来，转成文字，再标注
sentences.en: Record it, convert it to text, then annotate

sentences.zh: 周二的课，他准备的内容四十五分钟就讲完了。
sentences.en: In Tuesday's class, he got through the material he'd prepared in just forty-five minutes.

sentences.zh: 于是他临时设计了小组讨论：
sentences.en: So he improvised a small-group discussion:

sentences.zh: 第一轮：不录音，先练一遍。
sentences.en: Round one: no recording, just practice it once first.

sentences.zh: 第二轮：录音，争取说满六分钟。
sentences.en: Round two: record it, and try to speak for a full six minutes.

sentences.zh: 然后用手机转成文字，按姓名标出每个说话人，再给用到的“句型积木”划线。
sentences.en: Then they used a phone to convert it to text, labeled each speaker by name, and underlined the "sentence-pattern building blocks" they used.

sentences.zh: 这一套花了大约三十五到四十分钟。
sentences.en: This whole process took about thirty-five to forty minutes.

sentences.zh: “凑数内容”和“为什么是 a European Union？”
sentences.en: "Filler content" and "why is it a European Union?"

sentences.zh: 有同事说，这个学期是“前重后轻”：前面新内容多，后面基本在凑数。
sentences.en: A colleague said this semester is "front-heavy": lots of new content at the start, and mostly filler later on.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的看法是，学语言本来就没什么新鲜事：花在一门语言上的时间越多，学得就越好。
sentences.en: Steven's view is that there's nothing new about learning a language: the more time you spend on it, the better you get.

sentences.zh: 今天有学生问，为什么是 “a European Union”，不是 “an”。
sentences.en: Today a student asked why it's "a European Union" and not "an".

sentences.zh: 他的回答是：“这个问题问 DeepSeek 吧，问豆包吧，别问我。”
sentences.en: His answer was: "Ask DeepSeek, ask Doubao, don't ask me."

sentences.zh: 接着又有人问：为什么说 the United States，却不说 the Kenya？
sentences.en: Then someone else asked: why do we say "the United States" but not "the Kenya"?

sentences.zh: 再往下就是“Ukraine 还是 the Ukraine”，那可是外交上的雷区了。
sentences.en: Next up would be "Ukraine or the Ukraine", and that's a real diplomatic minefield.

sentences.zh: 他很高兴学生爱提问，不过深入的语法分析，AI 比他在行。
sentences.en: He's glad his students love asking questions, but AI is better than him at in-depth grammar analysis.

sentences.zh: ‍ 听课检查与 CELTA 的回忆
sentences.en: Class observations and memories of CELTA

sentences.zh: 系主任会去听每位新老师的课，她听了史蒂文的第一节。
sentences.en: The department head observes every new teacher's class, and she sat in on Steven's first one.

sentences.zh: 他有点紧张。
sentences.en: He was a little nervous.

sentences.zh: 下周，国际部的主任也要来，还要他提交带教学目标的教案。
sentences.en: Next week, the head of the international department is coming too, and she wants him to hand in a lesson plan with teaching objectives.

sentences.zh: 他自从考完 CELTA 就没写过教案。
sentences.en: He hasn't written a lesson plan since he finished his CELTA.

sentences.zh: 在韩国时，他的搭档老师教案满天飞，他自己什么都没有，但是“我有魅力，有感染力，有乐趣”。
sentences.en: In Korea, his co-teacher had lesson plans everywhere while he had nothing, but "I had charisma, I had energy, I had fun."

sentences.zh: 学生从来看不到你的教案。
sentences.en: Students never see your lesson plan.

sentences.zh: 他们感受到的是：你的课，自己是不是怕上。
sentences.en: What they feel is whether or not they dread coming to your class.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文给他们的，是互动、故事，是聊美食、聊游戏、聊睡眠。
sentences.en: What Steven gave them was interaction and stories — chatting about food, games, and sleep.

sentences.zh: “克劳德先生”的单词卡
sentences.en: Mr. Claude's flashcards

sentences.zh: 课后，班主任说：“令人印象深刻。”
sentences.en: After class, the homeroom teacher said: "Impressive."

sentences.zh: 他觉得功劳在单词卡。
sentences.en: He thinks the credit goes to the flashcards.

sentences.zh: 他的 AI 助手（他管它叫 Claudet 先生，听起来更高雅）做了 PDF 卡组：一张卡是填空题，下一张是答案，内容涉及冠词、名词的 s 结尾，以及 he/she/it/they。
sentences.en: His AI assistant (he calls it Mr. Claudet, which sounds classier) made a PDF deck: one card is a fill-in-the-blank question, the next is the answer, covering articles, the s ending on nouns, and he/she/it/they.

sentences.zh: 他先用儿童版示范：“你奶奶，是 he、she 还是 it？”
sentences.en: He first demonstrated with a kids' version: "Your grandma — is she he, she or it?"

sentences.zh: 再换成学生作文里的真实词汇。
sentences.en: Then he switched to real vocabulary from the students' essays.

sentences.zh: 然后他在屏幕上放了八分钟倒计时：“站起来，把椅子推进去，去认识三个不同的人。”
sentences.en: Then he put an eight-minute countdown on the screen: "Stand up, push your chair in, and go meet three different people."

sentences.zh: 目标是做到脱口而出。
sentences.en: The goal was for the answers to come out without thinking.

sentences.zh: 至于达没达到，就见仁见智了。
sentences.en: Whether that was achieved is a matter of opinion.

sentences.zh: 他承认，十四个小组里，只有大约三组把转写任务做对了。
sentences.en: He admits that of fourteen groups, only about three did the transcription task correctly.

sentences.zh: 他的“讲解清晰度”得分也低于平均，他自己也认同。
sentences.en: His score for "clarity of explanation" was also below average, and he agrees with it himself.

sentences.zh: 个人 PPT 和词汇“小窍门”
sentences.en: Personal PPTs and the vocabulary "hack"

sentences.zh: 每节课都以个人 PPT 开场：讲两三分钟，四张幻灯片，不看讲稿。
sentences.en: Every class opens with a personal PPT: two or three minutes of talking, four slides, no notes.

sentences.zh: 这是 CELTA 的老套路：提高学生说话时间（STT），压低老师说话时间（TTT）。
sentences.en: It's an old CELTA trick: raise student talking time (STT) and cut teacher talking time (TTT).

sentences.zh: 听众要挑出三个“大词”。
sentences.en: The audience has to pick out three "big words".

sentences.zh: 今天物联网专业的课上，一个女生刚讲完，她的朋友就把三个词发进了微信群。
sentences.en: In today's Internet of Things class, the moment one girl finished her talk, her friend posted the three words in the WeChat group.

sentences.zh: 男生们没话可补，反正在那个班，他们本来也不爱和女生说话。
sentences.en: The boys had nothing to add; in that class they don't like talking to the girls anyway.

sentences.zh: “向各位女生致敬，你们破解了个人 PPT。”
sentences.en: "Respect to all you girls, you've cracked the personal PPT."

sentences.zh: 唯一的禁区是篮球：“把它留作爱好……别拿来当作业。”
sentences.en: The only off-limits topic is basketball: "Keep it as a hobby… don't use it for homework."

sentences.zh: ⏳ 期中考试与“消失的一年”
sentences.en: ⏳ The midterm exams and the "lost year"

sentences.zh: 口语期中考试在第十五周，现在是第十二周。
sentences.en: The oral midterm is in week fifteen, and it's now week twelve.

sentences.zh: 笔试定在 1 月 4 日周一，他有点担心：有些作文，写的正是他幻灯片上明令禁止的内容。
sentences.en: The written exam is set for Monday, January 4, and he's a bit worried: some of the essays cover exactly what his slides explicitly prohibited.

sentences.zh: 然后是批改，一转眼就到 2027 年了。
sentences.en: Then comes the grading, and in the blink of an eye it's 2027.

sentences.zh: 机器人检查机器人
sentences.en: Robots checking robots

sentences.zh: 他的难题是，自己生成的内容，没法一一审查。
sentences.en: His problem was that he couldn't review all the content he generated one by one.

sentences.zh: 于是他问 Claude：能不能在夜里自动检查，又不消耗他的 Claude 额度？
sentences.en: So he asked Claude: could it check automatically overnight without using up his Claude quota?

sentences.zh: 它写了一个绑定谷歌表格的 Google Apps Script，用免费的 API 密钥调用 Gemini。
sentences.en: It wrote a Google Apps Script linked to a Google Sheet that calls Gemini with a free API key.

sentences.zh: Gemini 老是碰到用量上限，他就加了 OpenAI 密钥作后备，每次检查只花不到一分钱。
sentences.en: Gemini kept hitting its usage limit, so he added an OpenAI key as a backup; each check costs less than a cent.

sentences.zh: 今早，他收到了二十五部做好的英语漫画。
sentences.en: This morning, he received twenty-five finished English comics.

sentences.zh: 他想把同样的流程用在视频片段和 Substack 上，让 Gemini 检查 Claude 和 Codex 做的版本。
sentences.en: He wants to use the same process for video clips and Substack, having Gemini check the versions made by Claude and Codex.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 评价、听课、AI 检查，说到底都是反馈循环，只有真正照着改，才有用。
sentences.en: Reviews, attending classes, AI checks: in the end they're all feedback loops, and they only help if you actually make the changes.

sentences.zh: 会自我纠错的 AI，是大批量产出内容的关键吗？
sentences.en: Is self-correcting AI the key to producing content at scale?

sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。
sentences.en: We'll wait and see.

vocab.en: to blurt out; to say without thinking
